headline: Iraq Presses OPEC+ for Higher Production Quota Ahead of Policy Meeting
summary: Iraq is negotiating with OPEC for permission to produce more oil to develop its energy infrastructure, though members have largely agreed to keep production ceilings steady.
why: OPEC+ production quotas regulate global oil supply, directly impacting crude prices and the revenues of petroleum-dependent economies.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Higher production quotas would directly impact Iraq's export volumes and national revenue.
